questions.question: List the objectives of National Entrepreneurship Development Board.
questions.solution_html:
• List the objectives of National Entrepreneurship Development Board.
  • Objectives of National Entrepreneurship Development Board (NEDB)
  • Promotion of Entrepreneurship
  • To promote and develop entrepreneurship in the country by encouraging individuals to start new
  • enterprises.
  • Training and Development
  • To organize and support entrepreneurship development programmes (EDPs) for developing
  • entrepreneurial skills among people.
  • Coordination of Institutions
  • To coordinate the activities of various institutions engaged in entrepreneurship development and
  • training.
  • Research and Development
  • To promote research, studies, and surveys related to entrepreneurship and small business
  • development.
  • Support to New Entrepreneurs
  • To provide guidance, information, and assistance to new and potential entrepreneurs in
  • establishing their enterprises.
  • Development of Entrepreneurial Culture
  • To create awareness and develop an entrepreneurial culture in society.
questions.final_answer: To create awareness and develop an entrepreneurial culture in society

questions.question: Describe the importance of partnership deed.
questions.solution_html:
• A partnership deed is a written agreement between the partners of a partnership firm that defines
  • the terms and conditions of the business.
  • Importance
  • Defines Rights and Duties
  • It clearly states the rights, duties, and responsibilities of each partner.
  • Profit and Loss Sharing
  • It specifies the ratio in which profits and losses are shared among partners.
  • Avoids Conflicts
  • A written agreement helps prevent misunderstandings and disputes among partners.
  • Provides Legal Evidence
  • The partnership deed acts as legal proof in case of disputes or legal matters.
  • Clarifies Business Rules
  • It includes rules regarding capital contribution, interest on capital, salary to partners, and
  • admission or retirement of partners.
questions.final_answer: admission or retirement of partners
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Define business opportunity and explain its characteristics in detail.
questions.solution_html:
• Definition of Business Opportunity
  • A business opportunity refers to a favorable set of circumstances in the market that allows an
  • individual or a firm to start a new business or expand an existing one with the expectation of
  • earning profits. It is essentially a chance to meet consumer needs, solve problems, or provide
  • goods and services in a way that creates value.
  • In short: A business opportunity is a potential idea or market gap that can be converted into a
  • successful business venture.
  • Characteristics of a Business Opportunity
  • Profitability
  • A genuine business opportunity should have the potential to generate reasonable profit. Without
  • the possibility of financial gain, the opportunity is not viable.
  • Market Demand
  • There must be demand for the product or service in the market. Understanding customer needs
  • and preferences is critical to ensure success.
  • Feasibility
  • The opportunity should be technically, financially, and operationally feasible. This includes
  • availability of resources, technology, skills, and funds to implement the business idea.
  • Scalability
  • A good business opportunity has the potential to grow and expand over time. It should allow the
  • business to increase production, enter new markets, or diversify products.
  • Innovativeness
  • Opportunities often arise from innovation or improvement in products, services, or processes.
  • Creativity and uniqueness help a business stand out from competitors.
  • Low Risk or Manageable Risk
  • Every business involves risk, but a viable business opportunity should have risks that can be
  • identified, evaluated, and managed effectively.
  • Resource Availability
  • The success of a business opportunity depends on the availability of raw materials, manpower
  • technology, and financial resources.
  • Legal and Social Acceptability
  • The business idea should comply with legal regulations and ethical standards. It should be
  • socially acceptable and environmentally responsible.
questions.final_answer: socially acceptable and environmentally responsible
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Define business opportunity and explain its characteristics in detail.
questions.solution_html:
• Definition of Business Opportunity
  • A business opportunity refers to a favorable set of circumstances in the market that allows an
  • individual or a firm to start a new business or expand an existing one with the expectation of
  • earning profits. It is essentially a chance to meet consumer needs, solve problems, or provide
  • goods and services in a way that creates value.
  • In short: A business opportunity is a potential idea or market gap that can be converted into a
  • successful business venture.
  • Characteristics of a Business Opportunity
  • Profitability
  • A genuine business opportunity should have the potential to generate reasonable profit. Without
  • the possibility of financial gain, the opportunity is not viable.
  • Market Demand
  • There must be demand for the product or service in the market. Understanding customer needs
  • and preferences is critical to ensure success.
  • Feasibility
  • The opportunity should be technically, financially, and operationally feasible. This includes
  • availability of resources, technology, skills, and funds to implement the business idea.
  • Scalability
  • A good business opportunity has the potential to grow and expand over time. It should allow the
  • business to increase production, enter new markets, or diversify products.
  • Innovativeness
  • Opportunities often arise from innovation or improvement in products, services, or processes.
  • Creativity and uniqueness help a business stand out from competitors.
  • Low Risk or Manageable Risk
  • Every business involves risk, but a viable business opportunity should have risks that can be
  • identified, evaluated, and managed effectively.
  • Resource Availability
  • The success of a business opportunity depends on the availability of raw materials, manpower
  • technology, and financial resources.
  • Legal and Social Acceptability
  • The business idea should comply with legal regulations and ethical standards. It should be
  • socially acceptable and environmentally responsible.
questions.final_answer: socially acceptable and environmentally responsible
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026
